text: The Karr et al. (2012) whole-cell model of Mycoplasma genitalium took only a few person-months to build, and has since been extended into an equally complete whole-cell model of E. coli.
explanation: This is false: building the M. genitalium whole-cell model actually took approximately 128 person-years, reflecting the enormous effort of integrating 28 submodels and estimating their parameters. A comparably complete whole-cell model of the much larger and more complex E. coli genome does not yet exist in this material -- E. coli has instead been the subject of more limited ME-models (metabolism and expression models), which are not the same as a full whole-cell model.
